_comment: Pelican Panel Egg for LavaMusic (https://github.com/AeCyrexus/Lavalink). Generated for lavamusic 4.7.0 (Bun runtime).
name: LavaMusic
author: egg@zephycube.com
description: LavaMusic is a feature-rich Discord music bot built with discord.js, TypeScript, and lavalink-client, built from AeCyrexus/Lavalink. Requires a separate Lavalink audio server (this repo is the bot, not the Lavalink server jar).
startup: if echo "${DATABASE_URL}" | grep -qE '(^sqlite:|\.db$|\.sqlite$)'; then bun run db:push:sqlite; else bun run db:push; fi && bun run dist/index.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Bun App Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python python-dev libtool
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server


mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "assuming user knows what they are doing have a good day."
    exit 0
fi

## add git ending if it's not on the address
if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    echo -e "using anon api call"
else
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

## pull git js bot repo
if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
    echo -e "/mnt/server directory is not empty."
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo -e ".git directory exists"
        if [ -f .git/config ]; then
            echo -e "loading info from git config"
            ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url)
        else
            echo -e "files found with no git config"
            echo -e "closing out without touching things to not break anything"
            exit 10
        fi
    fi

    if [ "${ORIGIN}" == "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
        echo "pulling latest from github"
        git pull
    fi
else
    echo -e "/mnt/server is empty.\ncloning files into repo"
    if [ -z ${BRANCH} ]; then
        echo -e "cloning default branch"
        git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    else
        echo -e "cloning ${BRANCH}'"
        git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi
fi


echo "Installing bun packages"
if [[ ! -z ${BUN_PACKAGES} ]]; then
    bun install ${BUN_PACKAGES}
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    bun install
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/scripts/generate-registry.ts ]; then
    bun run generate
fi

bun run build

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Bot Token
variables.description: Your Discord bot token from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables.name: Client ID
variables.description: Your Discord application's Client ID. Needed for /invite and /about commands.

variables.name: Lavalink Nodes
variables.description: JSON array of Lavalink node connections. Example: [{"id":"Local Node","host":"lavalink","port":2333,"authorization":"youshallnotpass","retryAmount":5,"retryDelay":60000,"secure":false}]

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Connection string for the bot's database. Use "file:./lavamusic.db" for SQLite, or a postgres:// URL for PostgreSQL.

variables.name: Default Language
variables.description: Default locale for the bot (e.g. en-US).

variables.name: Prefix
variables.description: Message command prefix (only used if message-based commands are enabled).

variables.name: Owner IDs
variables.description: JSON array of Discord user IDs with bot owner permissions. Example: ["123456789012345678"]

variables.name: Guild ID
variables.description: Restrict the bot to a single server by ID. Leave blank for global use.

variables.name: Top.gg Token
variables.description: Top.gg API token for posting bot stats (optional).

variables.name: Log Channel ID
variables.description: Discord channel ID for Lavalink node status and guild join/leave logs (optional).

variables.name: Log Commands Channel ID
variables.description: Discord channel ID where command usage logs are sent (optional).

variables.name: Bot Status
variables.description: Bot's online presence status.

variables.name: Activity Type
variables.description: Discord activity type: 0=Playing, 1=Streaming, 2=Listening, 3=Watching, 4=Custom, 5=Competing.

variables.name: Activity Text
variables.description: Text shown in the bot's activity status.

variables.name: Search Engine
variables.description: Default search engine used when playing songs.

variables.name: Genius API Token
variables.description: Client token from genius.com for fetching lyrics (optional).

variables.name: Git Repository Address
variables.description: The git repository to install LavaMusic from.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to clone. Leave blank to use the repository's default branch.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Only needed if GIT_ADDRESS points to a private repository.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Only needed if GIT_ADDRESS points to a private repository (personal access token).

variables.name: Skip Install (Manual Upload)
variables.description: Set to true/1 if you've manually uploaded the bot files and want to skip cloning/building entirely.

variables.name: Extra Bun Packages
variables.description: Space-separated list of extra packages to install with bun (optional).
